summary: Insert or move a node before a reference child, preserving Node.insertBefore return and error semantics.

semantics.reference_validation: non-null child must be a child of parent or NotFoundError
semantics.mutation: moves existing node; DocumentFragment expands its children

caveats: Preserve Web IDL null handling; an omitted second argument is not generally identical to passing null in every binding shape.
references: WHATWG DOM Living Standard § Node.insertBefore / pre-insert
